overall_notes: This paper presents DPP-TTS, a Text-to-Speech model focusing on prosodic diversity. The evaluation uses both automatic metrics (σ_p for within-sample diversity, determinant for between-sample diversity) and human evaluation (side-by-side comparison and MOS). The extraction was generally accurate with minor duplication and normalization issues.
